Thanks for letting me know. I won't use the plate you gave earlier, since it isn't your vehicle. To find your account, please send the plate on your own vehicle or your repair-order number (RO-######), along with the last name on the account.

I also need to correct my colleague's earlier message. I can't confirm the inspection length or any charge details until I've checked your account. Any charge would be explained in the inspection report before you pay.
